stories.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
stories.simple_summary: Meta has created an animated character powered by AI that can have video calls with you. You can customize how this character looks and acts.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly interesting to people who like trying new tech toys. Most small business owners won't need this right now.

stories.title: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder
stories.simple_summary: Meta is worried that communities don't want giant data centers built near them, which could slow down their plans to build more AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors. It won't directly affect your business or daily life unless you live near a proposed data center.

stories.title: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI released a new AI tool designed to help find and fix computer security problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important for large companies and tech professionals. Small business owners should focus on basic security like strong passwords instead.

stories.title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI's leader says the company might become publicly traded by 2027, meaning regular people could buy stock in it.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors interested in tech companies. It doesn't change how AI works or affects your daily life.

stories.title: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
stories.simple_summary: Claude, an AI assistant, can now look at your bank accounts and credit cards to answer questions about your spending and money.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Claude and want help tracking where your money goes, this could be helpful. You should only use it if you trust both Claude and the service connecting to your bank.

stories.title: Claude AI can plug directly into your bank account
stories.simple_summary: Claude can now connect directly to your bank and card accounts to help you understand your spending habits.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're comfortable sharing your banking information with AI, this could help you see spending patterns. Most people should stick with their bank's own money tools for now.

stories.title: ‘Total repudiation’: The blue wave is about to hit AI
stories.simple_summary: This headline discusses election results but doesn't explain what it has to do with AI.
stories.why_it_matters: You can't tell from this headline how it relates to AI or why it matters. Skip this one.

stories.title: Parents Sue Google Over A.I. Safety Risks on School Chromebooks
stories.simple_summary: Parents are suing Google because they're concerned about AI safety problems on school computers called Chromebooks.
stories.why_it_matters: If your grandchildren use Chromebooks at school, this reminds us that schools should think carefully about AI tools. You might want to talk with schools about what AI features are active on student devices.

stories.title: Grimes is going to star in an AI movie that’s coming to theaters
stories.simple_summary: A movie made mostly by AI will appear in movie theaters, and pop star Grimes will act in it.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly entertainment news. AI-made movies are still experimental, and most films you watch won't be created this way anytime soon.

stories.title: OpenAI says its new cybersecurity model is better at not hacking other companies
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI released an improved AI tool for cybersecurity that finds computer vulnerabilities more effectively and is less likely to cause unintended damage.
stories.why_it_matters: This is technical news for security professionals. Regular people don't need to do anything with this information.

stories.title: Axiom Math wants to keep AI slop out of mathematics
stories.simple_summary: A new AI startup is using AI to check if mathematical proofs are correct, fighting against messy or wrong AI-generated math.
stories.why_it_matters: This only matters to mathematicians and researchers. It won't affect your daily life or business.

stories.title: Google’s AI success is putting its search dominance at risk
stories.simple_summary: Google's success with AI tools could threaten its position as the main search engine people use.
stories.why_it_matters: Google's search has competition now, but most people will keep using Google. You don't need to change anything about how you search.
